settings.body: Two of Canada's largest commercial furniture manufacturers — proven across government ministries, school boards, and corporate campuses. Full desk and workstation lines available.

settings.question: Can Ontario public-sector buyers purchase desks and workstations through OECM?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner. Eligible Ontario public-sector buyers — school boards, hospitals, municipalities, colleges, and not-for-profits — can order through the OECM agreement without running an open tender. Send your requisition to quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com or call 1-800-835-9565 to set up an OECM purchase order.

settings.question: Which brands do you carry for desks and workstations?
settings.answer: Brant Business Interiors is a storefront-authorized dealer for Global Furniture Group, OTG (Offices to Go), and Heartwood — the three brands you'll see most often across our desk and workstation builds. Heartwood is the typical pick for higher-end veneer and executive suites; OTG and Global cover the full range from single desks to multi-person workstations and benching configurations.

settings.question: What should I know about sit-stand and height-adjustable desks?
settings.answer: Many of our sit-stand desks use electric motor lift columns, and many models offer programmable height presets; basic electric and manual hand-crank options are available where budget or simplicity is the priority. The top surface, leg colour, and motor configuration are usually quoted together as a single line. For multi-unit orders we send one quote that itemizes each desk and its options so procurement can audit line items easily.

settings.question: Can you handle a multi-workstation office reconfiguration?
settings.answer: Yes. We've installed open-plan workstation projects from a handful of desks up to floor-wide reconfigurations. The flow is: quote → free 2D space plan from our design team → confirmed PO → install on a single day or a rolling schedule with your facilities team. We deliver and install across Ontario from Peterborough, with one point of contact coordinating the project.

settings.hero_subtitle: Height-adjustable and fixed-height commercial desks for Ontario institutions — delivered and installed.
settings.intro_text:
Office desks are the work surfaces a commercial workplace is built around — sit-stand and height-adjustable desks for all-day comfort, L-shape and single-surface desks for private offices, executive suites, reception desks, and multi-person workstations for open-plan floors. Brant Business Interiors supplies commercial-grade desks and workstations to school boards, hospitals, municipalities, and offices across Ontario, with delivery from Peterborough and on-site installation on volume orders.

Start with how the desk will be used: sit-stand & height-adjustable desks for all-day comfort, L-shape desks and single-surface desks for private offices, executive desks for senior offices, reception desks for front-of-house, and multi-person workstations for open-plan teams.

Brant Business Interiors is registered under our parent legal entity, Brant Basics, as an authorized OECM Supplier Partner — eligible Ontario public-sector buyers can order desks and workstations through the OECM agreement without an open tender.
